unique.describe: The values must all differ; placed so far: {{values}}.

sum.open_other: The values add up to {{total}} over {{count}} open cells

runs.wholeLine: the blocks of {{group}} ({{clue}}) and the gaps they need fill the whole {{line}}

hint.findingValue_other: {{reason}}. So {{value}} can be removed from the hatched cells.
